savings.reason: Final savings classification is withheld with the unresolved first-cessation/earlier-amendment gaps. The original and EO13138 have been read; neither shows an express savings clause preserving an independent committee command. See the research rationale for the material missing evidence.

research_rationale: EO13017 section 5 terminates the Commission 30 days after actual submission of its final report, with a two-year outside limit unless extended. EO13040 replaces section 3 with preliminary and final reporting deadlines of January 31 and March 30, 1998; those deadlines are not proof of submission. EO13040 and EO13056 change membership numbers only in section 1(a), so do not end the whole establishment/functions clause. EO13138 section 3(a), effective September 30, 1999 under section 9, formally revokes the order after the committee had already terminated and completed its work. The actual final-report submission date is absent, so an earlier trigger-based termination cannot be dated; using the September 5, 1998 outside limit as first cessation would skip that unresolved actual trigger.
unresolved_material_gaps: Actual final-report submission date is absent. Establish that date, apply section 5’s 30-day trigger, and compare the outside limit; March 30, 1998 is only a reporting deadline.
